label: terrain-core-opfs-restore-baseline
runCommand: TERRAIN_CORE_OPFS_BENCH=1 npx playwright test --config playwright.oocReopen.config.ts terrainCoreReopen

environment.browser: Chromium (Playwright 1.63.0, Desktop Chrome device profile), Vite dev server, real OPFS

method.fresh: computeTerrainCore on the main thread, 3 runs, first and best reported
method.restore: 5 runs of: SHA-256 key over the positions, OPFS read of core.bin and core.json, SHA-256 verify of the payload, header parse, typed-array copy; median and max reported
method.parity: every grid compared byte for byte with the fresh core; the scalar record compared as JSON
method.cloud: deterministic rolling surface, 1000 m span, tests/benchmark/terrainCoreRebuildCost.test.ts makeCloud

criterion: restore median <= 50% of fresh best at the large size
verdict: GO on the performance criterion: restore is about 1% of fresh compute at every size; the max restore (155 ms at 100k, a first-read cold start) is still under 3% of fresh.
notes: Fresh compute here runs on the main thread; production computes in a worker, so the wall time a user waits is the same order.
The record parity check is JSON-level; the persistence implementation must encode non-finite values explicitly, which JSON cannot carry.
